title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #12

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is a kaand in the Ramayan? (1 mark)
   A. A river
   B. A festival
   C. A prayer
   D. A section or book of the Ramayan

2. During which Jain festival is the Kalpasutra often read? (1 mark)
   A. Vasant Panchami
   B. Madaraka Day
   C. Paryushan
   D. Maha Shivratri

3. What does the Moon do in modern science? (1 mark)
   A. It is a planet
   B. It goes around the Earth
   C. It is a star
   D. It goes around Mars

4. On which date is International Yoga Day? (1 mark)
   A. 12 December
   B. 25 December
   C. 1 June
   D. 21 June

5. What is the Indian name for Friday? (1 mark)
   A. Somvaar
   B. Shukravaar
   C. Guruvaar
   D. Budhvaar

6. What does water often stand for in religious life? (1 mark)
   A. Noise
   B. Hunger
   C. Anger
   D. Purity and a clean heart

7. Which is an activity for International Yoga Day? (1 mark)
   A. Skipping class
   B. Staying at home only
   C. Doing yoga together at school or a park
   D. Playing loud music

8. Which of these is NOT one of the five elements? (1 mark)
   A. Metal
   B. Prithvi
   C. Vayu
   D. Agni

9. Budh is the Indian name for which planet? (1 mark)
   A. Jupiter
   B. Saturn
   C. Mars
   D. Mercury

10. What does dravinam mean in the prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Wealth
   B. Prayer
   C. Knowledge
   D. Mother

11. What does Kirat Karni mean? (1 mark)
   A. Fasting
   B. Earning by honest work
   C. Travelling
   D. Painting

12. Which planet is famous for its rings? (1 mark)
   A. Venus
   B. Saturn
   C. Mercury
   D. Mars

13. How should we treat a scripture? (1 mark)
   A. By writing on it
   B. With cleanliness and respect
   C. By throwing it
   D. By sitting on it

14. What does Pranayam mean? (1 mark)
   A. Prayer
   B. Song
   C. Breathing exercise
   D. Body posture

15. Which faith does the Dhammapada belong to? (1 mark)
   A. Buddhism
   B. Sikhism
   C. Hinduism
   D. Jainism

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain how to say the Gayatri Mantra correctly. (3 marks)

17. Match four scriptures with their faiths. (4 marks)

18. Compare Vajra Asana and Sasankasana. (5 marks)

19. Describe the snake story of Lord Parshvanath. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — A section or book of the Ramayan
   The Ramayan is divided into kaands.

2. C — Paryushan
   Many Jains listen to it during Paryushan.

3. B — It goes around the Earth
   The Moon is Earth's natural satellite.

4. D — 21 June
   21 June.

5. B — Shukravaar
   Shukra is Venus.

6. D — Purity and a clean heart
   Because water cleans, it is a sign of purity.

7. C — Doing yoga together at school or a park
   People do yoga together.

8. A — Metal
   The five are earth, water, fire, air and space.

9. D — Mercury
   Budh is Mercury.

10. A — Wealth
   Dravinam means wealth.

11. B — Earning by honest work
   Kirat Karni is honest labour.

12. B — Saturn
   Saturn has bright rings.

13. B — With cleanliness and respect
   Scriptures are kept clean and high.

14. C — Breathing exercise
   Pranayam is control of the breath.

15. A — Buddhism
   It is a collection of Buddhist verses.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Sit quietly with a straight back, close eyes and breathe slowly, say it one line at a time and listen first to a teacher or recording so you copy the sounds.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for three points.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: Ramayan: Hinduism. Kalpasutra: Jainism. Dhammapada: Buddhism. Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji: Sikhism.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each pair.

18. (5 marks)
   Answer: Vajra Asana is sitting on the heels with a straight back. Sasankasana starts in Vajra Asana and bends forward with the forehead on the mat and arms stretched forward. Both are calm and use steady breathing.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each pose and 1 mark for a similarity.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: A man was burning a log. Parshvanath saw that a snake was inside and asked him to stop. The snake was saved, and the man learned a lesson about kindness.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the log, 1 mark for the snake, 1 mark for the rescue or lesson.
